with-logotype.heading: With logotype (auto-scale on)
with-logotype.description: Header with a logotype. Logotype auto-scale is enabled by default - resize the browser to see the logotype scale fluidly between its minimum and maximum height.

with-logotype-fixed.heading: With logotype (auto-scale off)
with-logotype-fixed.description: Same header with the logotype auto-scale disabled. The logotype height is fixed regardless of screen or container size.

with-brand.heading: With brand
with-brand.description: Header using the brand component instead of logotype while keeping the rest of the header layout unchanged.

no-margin.heading: No margin (x and y disabled)
no-margin.description: Header with both horizontal and vertical margins disabled via --padding-x-enabled and --padding-y-enabled set to 0.
